Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to correctly interpret the search results from Step 1. The WebSurfer explicitly stated that William Pery served under "Lord Salisbury" (Robert Gascoyne-Cecil). However, in Step 2, the Planner incorrectly identified the supervising lord as "Lord Salisbury (Robert Gascoyne-Cecil, 3rd Marquess of Salisbury)" and proceeded to search for the position of the *3rd Marquess* in 1865-1868. This is a critical error because the 3rd Marquess did not exist in 1865-1868; he was the 2nd Marquess (his father) at that time, and he only inherited the title in 1868. By conflating the name "Salisbury" with the specific title "3rd Marquess" before verifying the timeline, the Planner set up a search for a non-existent entity in the specified timeframe, leading to the subsequent confusion and the failure to identify the correct title (Viscount Cranborne) which the 2nd Marquess held during 1865-1868.
